description: List current large-language-model API offerings with list prices (USD per 1M input/output tokens), long-context surcharge rules, context window and max output. Covers OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Mistral and Meta. Each response states the date the prices were last verified against the providers' own pricing pages — a model's training data is always out of date on this.

max_input_usd_per_1m.description: Only return models whose standard input price is at or below this.

provider.description: Only return models from this provider (e.g. "Anthropic"). Case-insensitive.

name: llm_models
title: List LLM models and prices
